CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ads.paid_banner_actor_allowed(p_account_id bigint, p_actor_id integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
SELECT CASE WHEN nullif(pg_catalog.current_setting('business.delegation_context',true),'') IS NOT NULL
 THEN public.business_gestao_ads_allowed(p_account_id,p_actor_id)
 ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_usuarios u WHERE u.id=p_actor_id AND (coalesce(u.is_admin,false) OR coalesce(u.is_dev,false))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_conta_usuarios m WHERE m.id_conta=p_account_id AND m.id_usuario=p_actor_id AND m.status::text='ATIVO' AND m.papel::text IN('OWNER','ADMIN','OPERADOR')) END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ads.paid_banner_content_valid(p_campaign_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ads.campaigns c
 JOIN ads.advertisements a ON a.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND a.account_id=c.account_id AND a.billing_model='CPC' AND a.ad_type='BANNER' AND a.core_event_id IS NULL AND a.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN ads.creatives r ON r.advertisement_id=a.advertisement_id AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.creative_type='IMAGE'
 JOIN ads.campaign_placements cp ON cp.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND cp.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN ads.placements p ON p.placement_id=cp.placement_id AND p.placement_key='rr-sidebar-banner-300x250' AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.format_key='IMAGE'
 WHERE c.campaign_id=p_campaign_id AND c.billing_model='CPC' AND c.cpc_bid>=0.51 AND c.budget_total>=c.cpc_bid AND (c.budget_daily IS NULL OR c.budget_daily>=c.cpc_bid)
 AND c.starts_at IS NOT NULL AND c.ends_at>c.starts_at AND ads.normalize_banner_scope(c.metadata->'banner_scope_v1') IS NOT NULL
 AND ads.paid_banner_public_https(a.destination_url) AND ads.paid_banner_public_https(r.image_url) AND ads.paid_banner_public_https(r.payload->>'mobile_image_url')
 AND length(btrim(r.alt_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND r.width BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND r.height BETWEEN 1 AND 8192
 AND (r.payload->>'mobile_width')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND (r.payload->>'mobile_height')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND jsonb_typeof(r.payload->'open_in_new_tab')='boolean'
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM ads.advertisements x WHERE x.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND x.status<>'ARCHIVED')=1
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM ads.creatives x WHERE x.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND x.status<>'ARCHIVED')=1
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM ads.campaign_placements x WHERE x.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND x.status='ACTIVE')=1);
$function$
FUNCTIONS.NAME: paid_banner_content_valid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ads.save_house_banner_campaign(p_campaign_id uuid, p_account_id bigint, p_placement_key text, p_name text, p_desktop_image_url text, p_desktop_width integer, p_desktop_height integer, p_mobile_image_url text, p_mobile_width integer, p_mobile_height integer, p_alt_text text, p_destination_url text, p_open_in_new_tab boolean, p_starts_at timestamp with time zone, p_ends_at timestamp with time zone, p_weight integer DEFAULT 1, p_priority integer DEFAULT 1, p_changed_by integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_legacy_banner_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id uuid, advertisement_id uuid, creative_id uuid, placement_id uuid, campaign_status text, result_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
    target ads.campaigns%ROWTYPE;
    target_advertisement ads.advertisements%ROWTYPE;
    target_creative ads.creatives%ROWTYPE;
    selected_placement ads.placements%ROWTYPE;
    mapped_campaign_id uuid;
    effective_campaign_id uuid := p_campaign_id;
    v_campaign_id uuid;
    v_advertisement_id uuid;
    v_creative_id uuid;
    v_result_status text;
    v_advertisement_count integer;
    v_creative_count integer;
    normalized_name text := nullif(trim(p_name), '');
    normalized_desktop_url text := nullif(trim(p_desktop_image_url), '');
    normalized_mobile_url text := nullif(trim(p_mobile_image_url), '');
    normalized_alt text := nullif(trim(p_alt_text), '');
    normalized_destination text := nullif(trim(p_destination_url), '');
    creative_payload jsonb;
    map_metadata jsonb;
BEGIN
    -- banner_scope_v1: institutional owner and canonical global admin actor.
    IF p_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM 1::bigint OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_usuarios actor WHERE actor.id=p_changed_by
          AND (coalesce(actor.is_admin,false) OR coalesce(actor.is_dev,false))
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Somente administrador RunnerHub salva HOUSE da conta institucional'; END IF;

    IF p_legacy_banner_id IS NOT NULL AND p_legacy_banner_id <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ID legado de banner deve ser positivo';
    END IF;

    IF p_legacy_banner_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT legacy.canonical_id
          INTO mapped_campaign_id
          FROM ads.legacy_id_map legacy
         WHERE legacy.legacy_schema = 'ads'
           AND legacy.legacy_table = 'tb_portal_banners'
           AND legacy.legacy_id = p_legacy_banner_id::text
           AND legacy.canonical_entity_type = 'CAMPAIGN';

        IF effective_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
            effective_campaign_id := mapped_campaign_id;
        ELSIF mapped_campaign_id IS NOT NULL
              AND mapped_campaign_id <> effective_campaign_id THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'ID legado ja aponta para outra campanha';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF p_account_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM public.tb_contas account
         WHERE account.id_conta = p_account_id
           AND account.status::text = 'ATIVA'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conta da campanha nao encontrada ou nao ativa';
    END IF;

    IF normalized_name IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nome do banner e obrigatorio';
    END IF;

    IF normalized_desktop_url IS NULL
       OR normalized_desktop_url !~ '^https://[^[:space:]]+$'
       OR normalized_mobile_url IS NULL
       OR normalized_mobile_url !~ '^https://[^[:space:]]+$' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Imagens desktop e mobile HTTPS sao obrigatorias';
    END IF;

    IF p_desktop_width IS NULL OR p_desktop_width <= 0
       OR p_desktop_height IS NULL OR p_desktop_height <= 0
       OR p_mobile_width IS NULL OR p_mobile_width <= 0
       OR p_mobile_height IS NULL OR p_mobile_height <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Dimensoes desktop e mobile positivas sao obrigatorias';
    END IF;

    IF normalized_alt IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Texto alternativo do banner e obrigatorio';
    END IF;

    IF normalized_destination IS NULL
       OR normalized_destination !~ '^https://[^[:space:]]+$' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Destino HTTPS valido e obrigatorio';
    END IF;

    IF p_starts_at IS NULL OR p_ends_at IS NULL
       OR p_ends_at <= p_starts_at THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Janela do banner e obrigatoria e deve ser valida';
    END IF;

    IF p_weight IS NULL OR p_weight <= 0
       OR p_priority IS NULL OR p_priority <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Peso e prioridade devem ser positivos';
    END IF;

    SELECT placement.*
      INTO selected_placement
      FROM ads.placements placement
     WHERE placement.placement_key = nullif(trim(p_placement_key), '')
       AND placement.placement_key = 'rr-sidebar-banner-300x250'
       AND placement.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND placement.format_key = 'IMAGE'
     FOR SHARE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Placement ativo de imagem nao encontrado';
    END IF;

    creative_payload := jsonb_build_object(
        'managed_by', 'ads_business',
        'product', 'HOUSE',
        'responsive', true,
        'desktop_image_url', normalized_desktop_url,
        'desktop_width', p_desktop_width,
        'desktop_height', p_desktop_height,
        'mobile_image_url', normalized_mobile_url,
        'mobile_width', p_mobile_width,
        'mobile_height', p_mobile_height,
        'open_in_new_tab', coalesce(p_open_in_new_tab, false)
    );

    IF p_legacy_banner_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        creative_payload := creative_payload || jsonb_build_object(
            'legacy_banner_id', p_legacy_banner_id
        );
    END IF;

    IF effective_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        v_campaign_id := gen_random_uuid();
        v_advertisement_id := gen_random_uuid();
        v_creative_id := gen_random_uuid();
        v_result_status := 'created';

        INSERT INTO ads.campaigns (
            campaign_id,
            account_id,
            name,
            billing_model,
            status,
            currency,
            target_device_class,
            target_country_code,
            starts_at,
            ends_at,
            created_by,
            updated_by,
            metadata
        )
        VALUES (
            v_campaign_id,
            p_account_id,
            normalized_name,
            'HOUSE',
            'DRAFT',
            'BRL',
            'ALL',
            'BR',
            p_starts_at,
            p_ends_at,
            p_changed_by,
            p_changed_by,
            jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                'managed_by', 'ads_business',
                'product', 'HOUSE',
                'ad_type', 'BANNER',
                'legacy_banner_id', p_legacy_banner_id
            ))
        );

        INSERT INTO ads.advertisements (
            advertisement_id,
            campaign_id,
            account_id,
            billing_model,
            ad_type,
            name,
            status,
            core_event_id,
            destination_url,
            created_by,
            updated_by,
            metadata
        )
        VALUES (
            v_advertisement_id,
            v_campaign_id,
            p_account_id,
            'HOUSE',
            'BANNER',
            normalized_name,
            'ACTIVE',
            NULL,
            normalized_destination,
            p_changed_by,
            p_changed_by,
            jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                'managed_by', 'ads_business',
                'product', 'HOUSE',
                'legacy_banner_id', p_legacy_banner_id
            ))
        );

        INSERT INTO ads.creatives (
            creative_id,
            advertisement_id,
            campaign_id,
            account_id,
            billing_model,
            ad_type,
            creative_type,
            status,
            title,
            image_url,
            alt_text,
            width,
            height,
            payload,
            created_by,
            updated_by
        )
        VALUES (
            v_creative_id,
            v_advertisement_id,
            v_campaign_id,
            p_account_id,
            'HOUSE',
            'BANNER',
            'IMAGE',
            'ACTIVE',
            normalized_name,
            normalized_desktop_url,
            normalized_alt,
            p_desktop_width,
            p_desktop_height,
            creative_payload,
            p_changed_by,
            p_changed_by
        );

        INSERT INTO ads.campaign_placements (
            campaign_id,
            account_id,
            billing_model,
            placement_id,
            status,
            priority,
            weight,
            metadata
        )
        VALUES (
            v_campaign_id,
            p_account_id,
            'HOUSE',
            selected_placement.placement_id,
            'ACTIVE',
            p_priority,
            p_weight,
            jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                'managed_by', 'ads_business',
                'product', 'HOUSE',
                'legacy_banner_id', p_legacy_banner_id
            ))
        );
    ELSE
        SELECT stored.*
          INTO target
          FROM ads.campaigns stored
         WHERE stored.campaign_id = effective_campaign_id
         FOR UPDATE;

        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Campanha de banner nao encontrada';
        END IF;

        IF target.account_id <> p_account_id
           OR target.billing_model <> 'HOUSE' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conta ou produto da campanha nao corresponde';
        END IF;

        IF target.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'PAUSED') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pause o banner antes de editar';
        END IF;

        SELECT count(*)
          INTO v_advertisement_count
          FROM ads.advertisements advertisement
         WHERE advertisement.campaign_id = target.campaign_id
           AND advertisement.account_id = target.account_id
           AND advertisement.billing_model = 'HOUSE'
           AND advertisement.ad_type = 'BANNER'
           AND advertisement.status <> 'ARCHIVED';

        IF v_advertisement_count <> 1 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Campanha deve possuir exatamente um anuncio BANNER';
        END IF;

        SELECT advertisement.*
          INTO target_advertisement
          FROM ads.advertisements advertisement
         WHERE advertisement.campaign_id = target.campaign_id
           AND advertisement.account_id = target.account_id
           AND advertisement.billing_model = 'HOUSE'
           AND advertisement.ad_type = 'BANNER'
           AND advertisement.status <> 'ARCHIVED'
         FOR UPDATE;

        SELECT count(*)
          INTO v_creative_count
          FROM ads.creatives creative
         WHERE creative.advertisement_id =
               target_advertisement.advertisement_id
           AND creative.status <> 'ARCHIVED';

        IF v_creative_count <> 1 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Banner deve possuir exatamente um criativo ativo';
        END IF;

        SELECT creative.*
          INTO target_creative
          FROM ads.creatives creative
         WHERE creative.advertisement_id =
               target_advertisement.advertisement_id
           AND creative.status <> 'ARCHIVED'
         FOR UPDATE;

        v_campaign_id := target.campaign_id;
        v_advertisement_id := target_advertisement.advertisement_id;
        v_creative_id := target_creative.creative_id;
        v_result_status := 'updated';

        UPDATE ads.campaigns campaign
           SET name = normalized_name,
               starts_at = p_starts_at,
               ends_at = p_ends_at,
               updated_by = p_changed_by,
               updated_at = clock_timestamp(),
               version = campaign.version + 1,
               metadata = campaign.metadata || jsonb_strip_nulls(
                   jsonb_build_object(
                       'managed_by', 'ads_business',
                       'legacy_banner_id', p_legacy_banner_id
                   )
               )
         WHERE campaign.campaign_id = v_campaign_id;

        UPDATE ads.advertisements advertisement
           SET name = normalized_name,
               status = 'ACTIVE',
               destination_url = normalized_destination,
               updated_by = p_changed_by,
               updated_at = clock_timestamp()
         WHERE advertisement.advertisement_id = v_advertisement_id;

        UPDATE ads.creatives creative
           SET status = 'ACTIVE',
               title = normalized_name,
               image_url = normalized_desktop_url,
               alt_text = normalized_alt,
               width = p_desktop_width,
               height = p_desktop_height,
               payload = creative_payload,
               updated_by = p_changed_by,
               updated_at = clock_timestamp()
         WHERE creative.creative_id = v_creative_id;

        UPDATE ads.campaign_placements link
           SET status = 'INACTIVE',
               updated_at = clock_timestamp()
         WHERE link.campaign_id = v_campaign_id
           AND link.placement_id <> selected_placement.placement_id;

        INSERT INTO ads.campaign_placements (
            campaign_id,
            account_id,
            billing_model,
            placement_id,
            status,
            priority,
            weight,
            updated_at,
            metadata
        )
        VALUES (
            v_campaign_id,
            p_account_id,
            'HOUSE',
            selected_placement.placement_id,
            'ACTIVE',
            p_priority,
            p_weight,
            clock_timestamp(),
            jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                'managed_by', 'ads_business',
                'product', 'HOUSE',
                'legacy_banner_id', p_legacy_banner_id
            ))
        )
        ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, placement_id)
        DO UPDATE SET status = 'ACTIVE',
                      priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
                      weight = EXCLUDED.weight,
                      updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at,
                      metadata = campaign_placements.metadata
                                 || EXCLUDED.metadata;
    END IF;

    IF p_legacy_banner_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM ads.legacy_id_map legacy
             WHERE legacy.legacy_schema = 'ads'
               AND legacy.legacy_table = 'tb_portal_banners'
               AND legacy.legacy_id = p_legacy_banner_id::text
               AND (
                   (legacy.canonical_entity_type = 'CAMPAIGN'
                    AND legacy.canonical_id <> v_campaign_id)
                   OR
                   (legacy.canonical_entity_type = 'ADVERTISEMENT'
                    AND legacy.canonical_id <> v_advertisement_id)
                   OR
                   (legacy.canonical_entity_type = 'CREATIVE'
                    AND legacy.canonical_id <> v_creative_id)
               )
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mapa legado aponta para outra entidade canonica';
        END IF;

        map_metadata := jsonb_build_object(
            'managed_by', 'ads_business',
            'migration', '2026-08-20_ads_v1_house_banner',
            'owner_account_id', p_account_id
        );

        INSERT INTO ads.legacy_id_map (
            legacy_schema,
            legacy_table,
            legacy_id,
            canonical_entity_type,
            canonical_id,
            metadata
        )
        VALUES
            (
                'ads', 'tb_portal_banners', p_legacy_banner_id::text,
                'CAMPAIGN', v_campaign_id, map_metadata
            ),
            (
                'ads', 'tb_portal_banners', p_legacy_banner_id::text,
                'ADVERTISEMENT', v_advertisement_id, map_metadata
            ),
            (
                'ads', 'tb_portal_banners', p_legacy_banner_id::text,
                'CREATIVE', v_creative_id, map_metadata
            )
        ON CONFLICT (
            legacy_schema,
            legacy_table,
            legacy_id,
            canonical_entity_type
        )
        DO UPDATE SET metadata = legacy_id_map.metadata || EXCLUDED.metadata;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT v_campaign_id,
           v_advertisement_id,
           v_creative_id,
           selected_placement.placement_id,
           stored.status,
           v_result_status
      FROM ads.campaigns stored
     WHERE stored.campaign_id = v_campaign_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ads.select_house_banner_candidate(p_placement_key text, p_requested_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), p_device_class text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_country_code character DEFAULT 'BR'::bpchar, p_region_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_banner_page text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id uuid, account_id bigint, advertisement_id uuid, creative_id uuid, placement_id uuid, placement_key text, ad_type text, core_event_id integer, destination_url text, billing_model text, price_candidate numeric, currency character, creative_type text, title text, body text, image_url text, alt_text text, width integer, height integer, creative_payload jsonb, priority integer, weight integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
WITH raw_context AS (
    SELECT nullif(trim(p_placement_key), '') AS placement_key,
           coalesce(p_requested_at, clock_timestamp()) AS requested_at,
           upper(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_device_class), ''), 'ALL'))
               AS device_class,
           upper(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_country_code), ''), 'BR'))
               AS country_code,
           upper(nullif(trim(p_region_code), '')) AS region_code,
           nullif(trim(NULL::text), '') AS anonymous_id_hash,
           ARRAY(
               SELECT DISTINCT upper(trim(value))
                 FROM unnest(coalesce(
                     ARRAY['BANNER']::text[],
                     ARRAY[]::text[]
                 )) value
                WHERE nullif(trim(value), '') IS NOT NULL
           ) AS allowed_ad_types,
           coalesce(
               ARRAY[]::uuid[],
               ARRAY[]::uuid[]
           ) AS excluded_campaign_ids
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT raw.*,
           raw.device_class IN ('ALL', 'DESKTOP', 'MOBILE')
           AND raw.country_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'
           AND cardinality(raw.allowed_ad_types) > 0
           AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM unnest(raw.allowed_ad_types) allowed(ad_type)
                WHERE allowed.ad_type NOT IN ('EVENT', 'BANNER')
           ) AS valid_context
      FROM raw_context raw
),
eligible_campaigns AS (
    SELECT campaign.campaign_id,
           campaign.account_id,
           campaign.billing_model,
           campaign.cpc_bid,
           campaign.currency,
           campaign.target_region_code,
           campaign.metadata AS banner_scope_metadata,
           campaign.frequency_cap_count,
           campaign.frequency_cap_window_minutes,
           placement.placement_id,
           placement.placement_key,
           placement.format_key,
           link.priority,
           link.weight,
           normalized.requested_at,
           normalized.region_code,
           normalized.anonymous_id_hash,
           normalized.allowed_ad_types
      FROM normalized
      JOIN ads.placements placement
        ON placement.placement_key = normalized.placement_key
       AND placement.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND (
           placement.device_class = 'ALL'
           OR placement.device_class = normalized.device_class
       )
      JOIN ads.campaign_placements link
        ON link.placement_id = placement.placement_id
       AND link.status = 'ACTIVE'
      JOIN ads.campaigns campaign
        ON campaign.campaign_id = link.campaign_id
       AND campaign.account_id = link.account_id
       AND campaign.billing_model = link.billing_model
       AND campaign.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND campaign.starts_at <= normalized.requested_at
       AND campaign.ends_at >= normalized.requested_at
       AND campaign.campaign_id <>
           ALL(normalized.excluded_campaign_ids)
       AND (
           campaign.target_device_class = 'ALL'
           OR campaign.target_device_class = normalized.device_class
       )
       AND (
           campaign.target_country_code IS NULL
           OR campaign.target_country_code::text = normalized.country_code
       )
       AND (
           campaign.target_region_code IS NULL
           OR campaign.target_region_code = normalized.region_code
       )
      JOIN public.tb_contas account
        ON account.id_conta = campaign.account_id
       AND account.status::text = 'ATIVA'
     WHERE normalized.valid_context
       AND (
           campaign.billing_model = 'HOUSE'
           OR (
               NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM ads.account_financial_holds hold
                    WHERE hold.account_id = campaign.account_id
                      AND hold.status = 'OPEN'
               )
               AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM ads.account_balances balance
                    WHERE balance.account_id = campaign.account_id
                      AND balance.currency = campaign.currency
                      AND balance.available_balance >= campaign.cpc_bid
               )
               AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM ads.campaign_budget_state budget
                    WHERE budget.campaign_id = campaign.campaign_id
                      AND budget.account_id = campaign.account_id
                      AND budget.currency = campaign.currency
                      AND budget.spent_total + campaign.cpc_bid
                          <= campaign.budget_total
                      AND (
                          campaign.budget_daily IS NULL
                          OR budget.spent_date <
                             ads.business_date(normalized.requested_at)
                          OR budget.spent_today + campaign.cpc_bid
                             <= campaign.budget_daily
                      )
               )
           )
       )
),
frequency_eligible AS (
    SELECT candidate.*
      FROM eligible_campaigns candidate
     WHERE candidate.frequency_cap_count IS NULL
        OR (
            (NULL::integer IS NOT NULL OR candidate.anonymous_id_hash IS NOT NULL)
            AND (
                SELECT count(*)
                  FROM ads.deliveries prior_delivery
                  JOIN ads.delivery_payloads prior_payload
                    ON prior_payload.delivery_id = prior_delivery.delivery_id
                 WHERE prior_delivery.campaign_id = candidate.campaign_id
                   AND prior_delivery.served_at >= candidate.requested_at
                       - make_interval(
                           mins => candidate.frequency_cap_window_minutes
                       )
                   AND prior_delivery.served_at <= candidate.requested_at
                   AND (
                       (
                           NULL::integer IS NOT NULL
                           AND prior_payload.user_id = NULL::integer
                       )
                       OR (
                           NULL::integer IS NULL
                           AND prior_payload.anonymous_id_hash =
                               candidate.anonymous_id_hash
                       )
                   )
            ) < candidate.frequency_cap_count
        )
),
campaign_creatives AS (
    SELECT candidate.*,
           selected.advertisement_id,
           selected.creative_id,
           selected.ad_type,
           selected.core_event_id,
           selected.event_region_code,
           selected.destination_url,
           selected.creative_type,
           selected.title,
           selected.body,
           selected.image_url,
           selected.alt_text,
           selected.width,
           selected.height,
           selected.creative_payload
      FROM frequency_eligible candidate
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT advertisement.advertisement_id,
                 creative.creative_id,
                 advertisement.ad_type,
                 advertisement.core_event_id,
                 upper(nullif(trim(core_event.estado), ''))
                     AS event_region_code,
                 advertisement.destination_url,
                 creative.creative_type,
                 creative.title,
                 creative.body,
                 creative.image_url,
                 creative.alt_text,
                 creative.width,
                 creative.height,
                 creative.payload AS creative_payload
            FROM ads.advertisements advertisement
            JOIN ads.creatives creative
              ON creative.advertisement_id = advertisement.advertisement_id
             AND creative.campaign_id = advertisement.campaign_id
             AND creative.account_id = advertisement.account_id
             AND creative.billing_model = advertisement.billing_model
             AND creative.ad_type = advertisement.ad_type
             AND creative.status = 'ACTIVE'
            LEFT JOIN public.tb_evento_corridas core_event
              ON core_event.id_evento = advertisement.core_event_id
           WHERE advertisement.campaign_id = candidate.campaign_id
             AND advertisement.account_id = candidate.account_id
             AND advertisement.billing_model = candidate.billing_model
             AND advertisement.ad_type = ANY(candidate.allowed_ad_types)
             AND advertisement.status = 'ACTIVE'
             AND (
                 (
                     advertisement.ad_type = 'EVENT'
                     AND candidate.format_key = 'NATIVE_EVENT'
                     AND core_event.id_evento IS NOT NULL
                     AND core_event.ativo
                 )
                 OR (
                     advertisement.ad_type = 'BANNER'
                     AND candidate.format_key = 'IMAGE'
                     AND advertisement.billing_model = 'HOUSE'
                     AND ads.banner_scope_matches(candidate.banner_scope_metadata, candidate.region_code, p_banner_page)
                 )
             )
           ORDER BY advertisement.created_at,
                    advertisement.advertisement_id,
                    creative.created_at,
                    creative.creative_id
           LIMIT 1
      ) selected
),
scored_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT candidate.*,
           CASE
               WHEN candidate.billing_model = 'CPC'
                AND candidate.ad_type = 'EVENT'
                   THEN ads.event_auction_relevance_factor(
                       candidate.target_region_code,
                       candidate.event_region_code,
                       candidate.region_code
                   )
               ELSE 1::numeric
           END AS relevance_factor,
           CASE
               WHEN candidate.billing_model = 'CPC'
                AND candidate.ad_type = 'EVENT'
                   THEN candidate.cpc_bid
                        * ads.event_auction_relevance_factor(
                            candidate.target_region_code,
                            candidate.event_region_code,
                            candidate.region_code
                        )
               ELSE 0::numeric
           END AS auction_score,
           ads.event_auction_tie_break(
               candidate.campaign_id::text
               || ':' || candidate.placement_id::text
               || ':' || candidate.requested_at::text,
               candidate.weight
           ) AS tie_breaker
      FROM campaign_creatives candidate
),
ranked_candidates AS (
    SELECT candidate.*,
           lead(candidate.auction_score) OVER (
               ORDER BY
                   CASE
                       WHEN candidate.billing_model = 'CPC'
                        AND candidate.ad_type = 'EVENT'
                           THEN 1
                       ELSE 0
                   END DESC,
                   candidate.auction_score DESC,
                   candidate.priority DESC,
                   candidate.tie_breaker,
                   candidate.campaign_id
           ) AS next_auction_score
      FROM scored_candidates candidate
)
SELECT candidate.campaign_id,
       candidate.account_id,
       candidate.advertisement_id,
       candidate.creative_id,
       candidate.placement_id,
       candidate.placement_key,
       candidate.ad_type,
       candidate.core_event_id,
       candidate.destination_url,
       candidate.billing_model,
       CASE
           WHEN candidate.billing_model = 'CPC'
            AND candidate.ad_type = 'EVENT'
               THEN ads.event_auction_price(
                   candidate.cpc_bid,
                   candidate.relevance_factor,
                   candidate.next_auction_score
               )
           ELSE 0::numeric
       END AS price_candidate,
       candidate.currency,
       candidate.creative_type,
       candidate.title,
       candidate.body,
       candidate.image_url,
       candidate.alt_text,
       candidate.width,
       candidate.height,
       candidate.creative_payload,
       candidate.priority,
       candidate.weight
  FROM ranked_candidates candidate
 ORDER BY
       CASE
           WHEN candidate.billing_model = 'CPC'
            AND candidate.ad_type = 'EVENT'
               THEN 1
           ELSE 0
       END DESC,
       candidate.auction_score DESC,
       candidate.priority DESC,
       candidate.tie_breaker,
       candidate.campaign_id
 LIMIT 1;
$function$
FUNCTIONS.NAME: select_house_banner_candidate

FUNCTIONS.DEFINITION:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ads.select_paid_banner_candidate(p_placement_key text, p_requested_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), p_device_class text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_country_code character DEFAULT 'BR'::bpchar, p_region_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_banner_page text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id uuid, account_id bigint, advertisement_id uuid, creative_id uuid, placement_id uuid, placement_key text, ad_type text, core_event_id integer, destination_url text, billing_model text, price_candidate numeric, currency character, creative_type text, title text, body text, image_url text, alt_text text, width integer, height integer, creative_payload jsonb, priority integer, weight integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
WITH eligible AS (
 SELECT c.*,a.advertisement_id,a.destination_url,r.creative_id,r.creative_type,r.title,r.body,r.image_url,r.alt_text,r.width,r.height,r.payload,p.placement_id,p.placement_key,cp.priority,cp.weight,
 CASE WHEN c.metadata->'banner_scope_v1'->>'regions_mode'='SELECTED' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.2 END AS relevance
 FROM ads.campaigns c JOIN public.tb_contas ac ON ac.id_conta=c.account_id AND ac.status::text='ATIVA'
 JOIN ads.campaign_placements cp ON cp.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND cp.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN ads.placements p ON p.placement_id=cp.placement_id AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.placement_key=p_placement_key AND p.placement_key='rr-sidebar-banner-300x250'
 JOIN ads.advertisements a ON a.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND a.ad_type='BANNER'
 JOIN ads.creatives r ON r.advertisement_id=a.advertisement_id AND r.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN ads.account_balances b ON b.account_id=c.account_id AND b.currency=c.currency AND b.available_balance>=c.cpc_bid
 JOIN ads.campaign_budget_state bs ON bs.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND bs.spent_total+c.cpc_bid<=c.budget_total
 WHERE c.billing_model='CPC' AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at<=p_requested_at AND c.ends_at>=p_requested_at
 AND p_device_class IN('ALL','DESKTOP','MOBILE') AND (p.device_class='ALL' OR p.device_class=p_device_class)
 AND (c.target_device_class='ALL' OR c.target_device_class=p_device_class) AND (c.target_country_code IS NULL OR c.target_country_code=p_country_code)
 AND (c.target_region_code IS NULL OR c.target_region_code=upper(btrim(p_region_code))) AND c.frequency_cap_count IS NULL
 AND (c.budget_daily IS NULL OR bs.spent_date<ads.business_date(p_requested_at) OR bs.spent_today+c.cpc_bid<=c.budget_daily)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ads.account_financial_holds h WHERE h.account_id=c.account_id AND h.status='OPEN')
 AND ads.banner_scope_matches(c.metadata,p_region_code,p_banner_page) AND ads.paid_banner_approved(c.campaign_id)
), ranked AS (
 SELECT e.*,lead(e.cpc_bid*e.relevance) OVER(ORDER BY e.cpc_bid*e.relevance DESC,e.campaign_id) AS next_score FROM eligible e
)
SELECT c.campaign_id,c.account_id,c.advertisement_id,c.creative_id,c.placement_id,c.placement_key,'BANNER'::text,NULL::integer,c.destination_url,'CPC'::text,
 ads.event_auction_price(c.cpc_bid,c.relevance,c.next_score,0.51),c.currency,c.creative_type,c.title,c.body,c.image_url,c.alt_text,c.width,c.height,c.payload,c.priority,c.weight
FROM ranked c ORDER BY c.cpc_bid*c.relevance DESC,c.campaign_id LIMIT 1;
$function$
FUNCTIONS.NAME: select_paid_banner_candidate

FUNCTIONS.DEFINITION:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ads.serve_delivery(p_served_event_id uuid, p_campaign_id uuid, p_advertisement_id uuid, p_creative_id uuid, p_placement_id uuid, p_token_hash text, p_expires_at timestamp with time zone, p_served_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), p_token_version smallint DEFAULT 1, p_user_id integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_anonymous_id_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_ip_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_device_class text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_country_code character DEFAULT NULL::bpchar, p_region_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_route_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_request_context jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_retention_until timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(delivery_id uuid, destination_url text, billing_model text, price_snapshot numeric, currency character, result_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    paid_banner_candidate record;
    paid_banner_price numeric;
    existing_event ads.events%ROWTYPE;
    selected_delivery ads.deliveries%ROWTYPE;
    new_delivery_id uuid;
    campaign ads.campaigns%ROWTYPE;
    advertisement ads.advertisements%ROWTYPE;
    creative ads.creatives%ROWTYPE;
    selected_placement ads.placements%ROWTYPE;
    eligible_entities record;
    account_is_active boolean;
    budget_available boolean;
    balance_available boolean;
    effective_retention timestamp with time zone;
    frequency_identity text;
    frequency_window_start timestamp with time zone;
    recent_delivery_count integer;
BEGIN
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
        hashtextextended(p_served_event_id::text, 91001)
    );

    SELECT event.*
      INTO existing_event
      FROM ads.events event
     WHERE event.event_id = p_served_event_id;

    IF FOUND THEN
        IF existing_event.event_type <> 'SERVED' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'event_id ja utilizado por outro tipo de evento';
        END IF;

        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT delivery.delivery_id,
               delivery.destination_url,
               delivery.billing_model,
               delivery.price_snapshot,
               delivery.currency,
               'already_recorded'::text
          FROM ads.deliveries delivery
         WHERE delivery.delivery_id = existing_event.delivery_id;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT current_campaign,
           current_advertisement,
           current_creative,
           current_placement
      INTO eligible_entities
      FROM ads.campaigns current_campaign
      JOIN ads.advertisements current_advertisement
        ON current_advertisement.advertisement_id = p_advertisement_id
       AND current_advertisement.campaign_id = current_campaign.campaign_id
       AND current_advertisement.account_id = current_campaign.account_id
       AND current_advertisement.billing_model = current_campaign.billing_model
      JOIN ads.creatives current_creative
        ON current_creative.creative_id = p_creative_id
       AND current_creative.advertisement_id =
           current_advertisement.advertisement_id
       AND current_creative.campaign_id = current_campaign.campaign_id
       AND current_creative.account_id = current_campaign.account_id
       AND current_creative.billing_model = current_campaign.billing_model
       AND current_creative.ad_type = current_advertisement.ad_type
      JOIN ads.campaign_placements campaign_placement
        ON campaign_placement.campaign_id = current_campaign.campaign_id
       AND campaign_placement.account_id = current_campaign.account_id
       AND campaign_placement.billing_model = current_campaign.billing_model
       AND campaign_placement.placement_id = p_placement_id
       AND campaign_placement.status = 'ACTIVE'
      JOIN ads.placements current_placement
        ON current_placement.placement_id = campaign_placement.placement_id
       AND current_placement.status = 'ACTIVE'
      LEFT JOIN public.tb_evento_corridas core_event
        ON core_event.id_evento = current_advertisement.core_event_id
     WHERE current_campaign.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
       AND current_campaign.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND current_advertisement.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND current_creative.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND (
           current_advertisement.ad_type <> 'EVENT'
           OR core_event.ativo
       )
       AND current_campaign.starts_at <= p_served_at
       AND current_campaign.ends_at >= p_served_at
       AND (
           current_placement.device_class = 'ALL'
           OR current_placement.device_class = p_device_class
       )
       AND (
           current_campaign.target_device_class = 'ALL'
           OR current_campaign.target_device_class = p_device_class
       )
       AND (
           current_campaign.target_country_code IS NULL
           OR current_campaign.target_country_code = p_country_code
       )
       AND (
           current_campaign.target_region_code IS NULL
           OR current_campaign.target_region_code = p_region_code
       )
     FOR SHARE OF
         current_campaign,
         current_advertisement,
         current_creative,
         campaign_placement,
         current_placement;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Campanha/anuncio/criativo/placement nao elegivel para entrega';
    END IF;

    -- Cada item selecionado acima e um registro composto. PostgreSQL nao
    -- distribui com seguranca quatro composites diretamente entre quatro
    -- variaveis %ROWTYPE; materializamos primeiro em record e depois atribuímos
    -- cada campo ao tipo de tabela correspondente.
    campaign := eligible_entities.current_campaign;
    advertisement := eligible_entities.current_advertisement;
    creative := eligible_entities.current_creative;
    selected_placement := eligible_entities.current_placement;
    IF campaign.billing_model='CPC' AND advertisement.ad_type='BANNER' THEN
        SELECT * INTO paid_banner_candidate FROM ads.select_paid_banner_candidate(selected_placement.placement_key,p_served_at,p_device_class,p_country_code,p_region_code,p_request_context->>'banner_page');
        IF NOT FOUND OR paid_banner_candidate.campaign_id<>campaign.campaign_id OR paid_banner_candidate.advertisement_id<>advertisement.advertisement_id OR paid_banner_candidate.creative_id<>creative.creative_id THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Banner pago nao elegivel no escopo/leilao ou revisao atual';
        END IF;
        paid_banner_price:=paid_banner_candidate.price_candidate;
        p_request_context:=coalesce(p_request_context,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object('paid_banner_auction',jsonb_build_object('price',paid_banner_price,'max_bid',campaign.cpc_bid,'region',p_region_code,'page',p_request_context->>'banner_page','version',1));
    END IF;
    -- banner_scope_v1: revalidate the locked campaign immediately before delivery.
    IF campaign.billing_model='HOUSE' AND advertisement.ad_type='BANNER'
       AND NOT ads.banner_scope_matches(campaign.metadata,p_region_code,p_request_context->>'banner_page') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Banner fora do escopo de pagina ou UF';
    END IF;


    SELECT (account.status::text = 'ATIVA')
      INTO account_is_active
      FROM public.tb_contas account
     WHERE account.id_conta = campaign.account_id;

    IF NOT coalesce(account_is_active, false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conta da campanha nao esta ativa';
    END IF;

    IF campaign.frequency_cap_count IS NOT NULL THEN
        frequency_identity := CASE
            WHEN p_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'user:' || p_user_id::text
            WHEN nullif(trim(p_anonymous_id_hash), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'anonymous:' || trim(p_anonymous_id_hash)
            ELSE NULL
        END;

        IF frequency_identity IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Campanha com frequency cap exige user_id ou anonymous_id_hash';
        END IF;

        -- Serializa entregas da mesma campanha/audiencia para que duas
        -- requisicoes concorrentes nao ultrapassem o limite.
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
            hashtextextended(
                campaign.campaign_id::text || ':' || frequency_identity,
                91004
            )
        );

        frequency_window_start := p_served_at - make_interval(
            mins => campaign.frequency_cap_window_minutes
        );

        SELECT count(*)::integer
          INTO recent_delivery_count
          FROM ads.deliveries previous_delivery
          JOIN ads.delivery_payloads previous_payload
            ON previous_payload.delivery_id = previous_delivery.delivery_id
         WHERE previous_delivery.campaign_id = campaign.campaign_id
           AND previous_delivery.served_at >= frequency_window_start
           AND previous_delivery.served_at <= p_served_at
           AND (
               (
                   p_user_id IS NOT NULL
                   AND previous_payload.user_id = p_user_id
               )
               OR
               (
                   p_user_id IS NULL
                   AND previous_payload.anonymous_id_hash =
                       trim(p_anonymous_id_hash)
               )
           );

        IF recent_delivery_count >= campaign.frequency_cap_count THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Frequency cap da campanha atingido';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF campaign.billing_model = 'CPC' THEN
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM ads.account_balances balance
             WHERE balance.account_id = campaign.account_id
               AND balance.currency = campaign.currency
               AND balance.available_balance >= campaign.cpc_bid
        )
          INTO balance_available;

        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM ads.campaign_budget_state state
             WHERE state.campaign_id = campaign.campaign_id
               AND state.account_id = campaign.account_id
               AND state.currency = campaign.currency
               AND state.spent_total + campaign.cpc_bid
                   <= campaign.budget_total
               AND (
                   campaign.budget_daily IS NULL
                   OR state.spent_date < ads.business_date(p_served_at)
                   OR state.spent_today + campaign.cpc_bid
                      <= campaign.budget_daily
               )
        )
          INTO budget_available;

        IF NOT balance_available OR NOT budget_available THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Saldo ou orcamento indisponivel para entrega CPC';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF p_expires_at <= p_served_at THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expiracao da entrega deve ser posterior ao served_at';
    END IF;

    IF length(trim(p_token_hash)) < 32 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'token_hash invalido';
    END IF;

    effective_retention := coalesce(
        p_retention_until,
        p_served_at + interval '30 days'
    );

    IF effective_retention <= p_served_at THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Retencao do payload deve ser futura';
    END IF;

    IF campaign.frequency_cap_window_minutes IS NOT NULL
       AND effective_retention < p_served_at + make_interval(
           mins => campaign.frequency_cap_window_minutes
       ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Retencao do payload deve cobrir a janela de frequency cap';
    END IF;

    new_delivery_id := gen_random_uuid();

    INSERT INTO ads.deliveries (
        delivery_id,
        campaign_id,
        account_id,
        advertisement_id,
        creative_id,
        placement_id,
        billing_model,
        ad_type,
        currency,
        price_snapshot,
        destination_url,
        served_at,
        expires_at,
        token_version,
        token_hash
    )
    VALUES (
        new_delivery_id,
        campaign.campaign_id,
        campaign.account_id,
        advertisement.advertisement_id,
        creative.creative_id,
        p_placement_id,
        campaign.billing_model,
        advertisement.ad_type,
        campaign.currency,
        coalesce(paid_banner_price, campaign.cpc_bid, 0),
        advertisement.destination_url,
        p_served_at,
        p_expires_at,
        p_token_version,
        trim(p_token_hash)
    )
    RETURNING * INTO selected_delivery;

    INSERT INTO ads.delivery_payloads (
        delivery_id,
        user_id,
        anonymous_id_hash,
        ip_hash,
        device_class,
        country_code,
        region_code,
        route_key,
        request_context,
        retention_until
    )
    VALUES (
        selected_delivery.delivery_id,
        p_user_id,
        p_anonymous_id_hash,
        p_ip_hash,
        p_device_class,
        p_country_code,
        p_region_code,
        p_route_key,
        coalesce(p_request_context, '{}'::jsonb),
        effective_retention
    );

    INSERT INTO ads.events (
        event_id,
        delivery_id,
        account_id,
        campaign_id,
        advertisement_id,
        creative_id,
        placement_id,
        billing_model,
        ad_type,
        currency,
        price_snapshot,
        event_type,
        source,
        occurred_at,
        valid,
        billable
    )
    VALUES (
        p_served_event_id,
        selected_delivery.delivery_id,
        selected_delivery.account_id,
        selected_delivery.campaign_id,
        selected_delivery.advertisement_id,
        selected_delivery.creative_id,
        selected_delivery.placement_id,
        selected_delivery.billing_model,
        selected_delivery.ad_type,
        selected_delivery.currency,
        selected_delivery.price_snapshot,
        'SERVED',
        'SERVER',
        p_served_at,
        true,
        false
    );

    PERFORM ads.apply_metric_delta(
        selected_delivery,
        ads.business_date(p_served_at),
        p_served => 1
    );

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT selected_delivery.delivery_id,
           selected_delivery.destination_url,
           selected_delivery.billing_model,
           selected_delivery.price_snapshot,
           selected_delivery.currency,
           'served'::text;
END;
$function$
FUNCTIONS.NAME: serve_delivery
